# Bochs SoftFloat transcendental extensions

These sources are the SoftFloat Release 3 / Bochs floating-point extensions as
carried by MAME (`3rdparty/softfloat3/bochs_ext`), pinned to MAME commit
`5cf9567feaaae59bf7f11b3db9f7b64ab7220425`.

Original Bochs SoftFloat extension licence text is retained in each source file
and summarised in `LICENSE.txt` for Runtime package notices. Include paths were
rewritten to use the TFX SoftFloat build's header search path.
